content.text:
I fixed the pricing page on phones. The three plan cards (Starter, Pro, Team) now stack in one column on narrow screens instead of staying in three squeezed columns.

The cause was in `site/css/pages.css`. The `.plans` grid was fixed at three columns, and it was missing from the `@media (max-width: 720px)` rule that collapses the other grids on small screens. I added `.plans` to that rule.

The visual test for the pricing page on a phone was failing before the change. All 28 functional and visual tests pass now, including that one. I didn't open the screenshot to look at the page myself.

I didn't commit anything.

STATUS: DONE
